question: In which year was the Rural Employment Generation Program launched in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1995.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rural Employment Generation Program** (REGP) was launched by the **Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises** in **1995.** 
 
• The program aims to create **sustainable employment opportunities** in rural areas by promoting **self-employment ventures** in non-farm sectors.
 
• REGP provides financial assistance to individuals and groups for setting up micro-enterprises in sectors such as **food processing, handicrafts, and textiles.**
 
• The program also offers training and skill development programs to enhance the** entrepreneurial skills** of rural youth.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Within the **Indian government** is the Ministry of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises.
 
• It is the highest executive body in India responsible for **creating and enforcing laws, rules,** and regulations pertaining to micro, small, and medium-sized businesses.
 
• It was established in **2007.**
 
• **New Delhi **serves as the headquarters.
